title: protium polybotryum subsp. blackii

It is a tropical tree native to the Guiana Shield in South America and is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions. The plant has been reported to have several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as cancer and cardiovascular disease. The therapeutic actions of Protium polybotryum subsp. blackii include its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities.
